items: Changing any of the three rows also needs `ccBGSSSE041_DLC2LvlMountedRieklingBoss` 000890:ccbgssse041-netchleather.esl (Netch Leather pack, named Riekling Rider, PcLevelMult 1 (15–50)): it takes its template from `DLC2LCharMountedRiekling`, which draws them, without `Stats` (it is listed below as an owner of that list).
`DLC2EncMountedRiekling02` and `03A` use `DLC2EncMountedRiekling01` as their template but not for `Stats`: changing the Rider does not change them.
`DLC2EncMountedRiekling` 0179D1:Dragonborn.esm is a mounted riekling with no template and level 20; it is under Placed only.
Every other mounted riekling record (the Chargers `03B`–`03E`, `DLC2LvlMountedRiekling`, `DLC2LvlMountedRieklingBoss` and `…BossNoRespawn`) carries `Stats` and follows its template or list.
